members.name: a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which single intent best describes what the customer is asking about?

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card the customer has received; can't activate it; how to activate.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open/use an account; opening accounts for children/teenagers.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or Android Pay with the card or to top up; setting them up or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Finding an ATM, which ATMs accept the card, where to withdraw cash.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits, topping up automatically when balance is low.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer made a transfer (often from their UK account, or into their own account) and the account BALANCE hasn't updated / the transfer isn't showing in the account or balance; includes 'how long does a transfer from my UK account take? I made one and it isn't showing up'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited money, cash or a cheque but the balance hasn't changed / the deposit isn't showing / the cheque is slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Can't add a beneficiary/payee or a beneficiary was rejected; ALSO the customer was told by a message that a transfer is 'not possible' or 'not allowed' (an explicit not-allowed/not-possible notice), especially when such transfers worked before.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer/payment they just made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired and the customer needs the new/replacement card; includes questions about the new card such as getting it shipped to a specific country (e.g. 'can I get this shipped to China?') or express fees to get the new card faster.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; whether merchants/shops/countries accept it.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card hasn't arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent; where is my card.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; when the card will arrive; getting the card by a certain date or faster/expedited.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account/app, or making a card that arrived show in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The card isn't working or never goes through when paying at shops or online, without the customer saying it was 'declined'/'rejected'; something wrong with the card in general (not ATM withdrawals).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; extra charge for using the card; fees on payments; vague complaints about hidden fees, too many fees, or being charged fees without knowing why.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase on the statement/app that the customer says they did not make or don't recognise (the message speaks of a payment, purchase, or something they didn't buy).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase/payment abroad.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for ATM cash withdrawal; are there ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Cash withdrawal on account that the customer did not make.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details compromised/copied or someone else may be using the card; suspicious activity, want card frozen due to fraud.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank supports or is available in; whether people living outside the UK (e.g. in the EU or elsewhere) can open an account or get a card; which countries cards can be mailed/shipped/delivered to; using the service while abroad.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase was explicitly declined, rejected or refused (the customer uses words like declined/rejected/not accepted/not approved).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Customer tried to withdraw cash / get money out of an ATM and it was declined, not authorised, or they weren't able to (even if they also ask whether the card works).
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unknown, unauthorised, unrecognised or fraudulent charge or direct debit on the account, or wanting to dispute a charge (used even when no direct debit is mentioned, if the message just says 'charge').
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions on disposable virtual cards; how many times they can be used.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are; where to see them; how they are determined.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An explicit small extra amount (£1, $1, €1, one pound, one dollar) charged or showing on the statement/account, even if pending or not recognised.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or didn't go through; error when making a transfer; the customer simply can't make / is unable to make a transfer (no 'not allowed' notice).
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding/exchange; can I hold money in a currency.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: The PIN for a new physical card: haven't received the PIN, where to find the PIN, how to get a PIN for the card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/second card, cards for others on the account.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a virtual card; where is my virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen; found lost card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen; how to access account/use card without phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wanting or ordering a (plastic/physical) card in general: 'how do I get a card?', 'I would like a physical card', ordering a new card, fees for a new card.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/login code; resetting it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment or purchase (not a transfer) is pending or hasn't gone through yet / when will my payment go through.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / still in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up hasn't shown up in the account yet: it is pending, still processing, slow, 'I topped up but the money isn't in my account', 'not sure the top-up went through', funds not available yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending, not yet cleared or in progress; customer has waited a long time for a transfer that is pending; also 'money was transferred/sent to me and I can't see it yet'.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblocking.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money into the account from others; salary; getting paid; currencies others can send.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Refund that hasn't appeared yet in the account.
criteria.request_refund: How to get or request a refund for a purchase.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment that was reverted, cancelled, returned or sent back to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (for top up) and currencies are supported.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt that was declined, rejected, got an error or failed; the card was declined for a top-up; top-up not working.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up that was cancelled, returned or reversed; 'the top-up money was in my account and now it's gone' when no card is mentioned.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up the account using a debit/credit card: how to do it, AND problems where the customer says they topped up with their card and the money disappeared/is gone/is missing (card named + money gone).
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer, or what transfers cost; also very short bare questions like 'why was I charged?' or 'will I get extra charges?' that give no other context. Not complaints about hidden fees or about being charged too many fees (those are card_payment_fee_charged).
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / add funds by transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent/transferred money and it hasn't arrived or been received yet: the recipient (friend, landlord, son, retailer) hasn't got it, or 'I transferred money but it is not here / not there yet' (without mentioning the balance); transfer taking too long to arrive. Includes 'I made a transfer within the country days ago and it is still not showing / not there yet'.
criteria.transfer_timing: General questions about how long transfers take or when money will arrive (e.g. transfers from the US, Europe), with no specific missing transfer being complained about.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Seeing, proving or verifying the source of the customer's funds: where the money in the account came from or flows from; whether they must show where their money/salary comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code for a top-up / verifying a card used for top-up.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave wrong amount of cash.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM cash withdrawal.
